title: Ashgrove fulfillment weekly status
brief: Can you build the weekly operations status page for Ashgrove Logistics' four U.S. fulfillment sites, week ending 2026-10-16? Leadership wants the headline numbers first: 48210 orders shipped, 96.4 percent on-time dispatch (target is 97.0), average dock-to-stock time of 3.8 hours, and 7 open safety observations. Then show how on-time dispatch has moved over the last eight weeks under a heading "On-time trend": W34 97.1, W35 97.4, W36 96.9, W37 97.2, W38 97.0, W39 96.8, W40 96.9, W41 96.4. Under "Sites", give each site's manager, orders shipped and on-time percentage: Reno NV, Alicia Tran, 11940, 97.8; Columbus OH, Marcus Bell, 14380, 97.2; Dallas TX, Priyanka Rao, 12115, 96.5; Savannah GA, Joel Okafor, 9775, 93.6. Savannah is the one people will look for, and Dallas is worth watching. Under "Needs attention": Savannah's container crane was out of service from 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-15, which left a backlog of 1150 orders that should be cleared by 2026-10-19 with approved overtime. Under "Next week": the crane inspection sign-off on 2026-10-18 and 220 seasonal associates starting on 2026-11-02. People will read this on their phones between meetings.

edit.request: Add W42 at 97.3 percent to the trend, change the headline on-time dispatch to 97.3, and replace Joel Okafor with Beatriz Navarro as the Savannah manager.
